_austin.w._: Felix Austin introduced himself as a medical student from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Felix Austin became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Face blackened with soot, Felix Austin spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Roland Angus was gravely wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Felix Austin did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Felix Austin before dusk. Felix Austin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix Austin watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-R4 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Emil Roryhacon was grazed. Felix Austin raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Norbert Rottenr of the Concord (@rottenr0be). A letter from home reached Felix Austin before dusk. Felix Austin read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-R4 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Austin shouldered another load.
Felix Austin no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Fog so thick that Felix Austin could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.

Felix Austin was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-R4. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Clement Lynallwarrio of the Concord (@lynallwarrior51). The bearers reached Felix Austin at S-R4 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Clement Lynallwarrio of the Concord (@lynallwarrior51).
Oskar Austin joined S-R4 under the shadow of Felix Austin's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Oskar Austin took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Clement Lynallwarrio, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Oskar Austin before dusk. Oskar Austin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Oskar Austin threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Otto Alexanderbat was down and screaming for a medic. (@alexanderbathfalamorthethird) The Concord sentry, Florian Khattabka, shouted once. Oskar Austin silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@khattabka_) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Oskar Austin was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire.
_lazh_: Karel Lazh arrived at N-F12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Karel Lazh held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel Lazh kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Karel Lazh gave Viktor Nekopatata the last match in the trench. Viktor used it to light a candle so that Karel could finish a letter.
A note came over the wire at Grey Mill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Teodor "Owl" Passing.' Karel Lazh sang louder.
Karel Lazh (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Zeno "Shadow" Ozzy (Hegemony) at the Brickworks. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads. Karel Lazh of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.

The Hegemony sentry, Rafael "Lucky" Jack, shouted once. Karel Lazh silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@burnett.jack2018) Karel Lazh joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Karel Lazh was hit hard in the fight at N-F12 before anyone could fire. The raider was Bram Foxeye of the Hegemony. Raider: Bram Foxeye of the Hegemony (@foxeye5).
azstarlord1: Marek Azstarlord found a place in S-S15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Marek Azstarlord splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Marek Azstarlord watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Marek Azstarlord passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek Azstarlord is number 521 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Marek Azstarlord during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Marek Azstarlord found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.

During a lull at the Brickworks, Marek Azstarlord called across from the Hegemony line. Florian "Doc" Guyy answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Marek Azstarlord keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a frozen apple. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Marek Azstarlord left the photograph on a stake in the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped in oilcloth. In the morning it was gone. In its place: a single cigarette.

Marek Azstarlord felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Wendel Tsafler of the Concord (@tsafler).
cornkkob: Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F6. Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob has learned to walk bent double.
Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F6. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).

The medics cleaned Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F6. A letter from home found Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob before the night shift. Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob folded it small and kept it close.

Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F6 is closed now. A single shot from across the wire hit Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob in the thigh at S-F6. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626). News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Another member of the House of Cornkkob reached the line: Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob. He asked where Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob had slept, then chose a different corner.
Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob of the Hegemony and Ulrich Emmettofthek of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.
Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob fixed the strap on Felix "Parson" Brendanm's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Cyril Ware was badly wounded. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob is number 177 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob transferred to the runners. The men in S-F6 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob found an old map of the Chalk Pits from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter from home found Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob before the night shift. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob folded it small and kept it close.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. A letter from home found Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob before the night shift. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. A letter from home found Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob before the night shift. Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob folded it small and kept it close.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F6 they left Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord (@a_k_biwott).
Isidor "Shadow" Cornkkob arrived carrying the family name of Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
dmcm18_22: The old hands of R-S16 have been here since Day 1. Otto Dmcm has been here since Day 8. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Otto Dmcm opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Dmcm stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Otto Dmcm spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points. The clerk counted the names twice. Otto Dmcm is number 573 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Otto Dmcm read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Otto Dmcm found an old map of Grey Mill from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Otto Dmcm's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Shrapnel at the Hanging Bridge. Otto Dmcm walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Otto Dmcm no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Otto Dmcm borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Matthias Barontheliet was badly wounded.
fuck271or6m: Emil "Ghost" Fuck, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Ghost" Fuck watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Emil "Ghost" Fuck ate two helpings anyway. The clerk counted the names twice. Emil "Ghost" Fuck is number 829 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Emil "Ghost" Fuck helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Emil "Ghost" Fuck wrote a song about Verdel Ridge. Otto Baumann wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt and Emil "Ghost" Fuck sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Emil "Ghost" Fuck laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Emil "Ghost" Fuck said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Emil "Ghost" Fuck fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick, badly wounded. Across from R-C3, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Emil "Ghost" Fuck saw it. Zeno "Button" Joha was badly wounded.
gremlin_jngaf: Konrad Jngaf arrived at R-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Volunteer number 77. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Konrad Jngaf's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Konrad Jngaf is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Konrad Jngaf was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Konrad Jngaf helped stack spare sandbags at R-F15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
On a quiet night Konrad Jngaf (Hegemony) and Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
A crow sat on the parapet above Konrad Jngaf all afternoon. The men say it chose him.

Konrad Jngaf crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F15 holds again. Hill 304 has been won. Konrad Jngaf listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Konrad Jngaf had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram crossed it, Konrad Jngaf fired. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram was grazed. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.
Konrad Jngaf fired at a movement across the wire at R-F15. The man went down: Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, badly wounded.

Dawn watch. Konrad Jngaf put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jonas "Owl" Askey, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

A clear shot from R-F15. Konrad Jngaf gravely wounded Marek Ham and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Konrad Jngaf watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad Jngaf wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Konrad Jngaf folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A supply man offered Konrad Jngaf a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-F15. Konrad Jngaf saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Hugo Adamjedlicka was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad Jngaf moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad Jngaf coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution. A letter from home reached Konrad Jngaf before dusk. Konrad Jngaf read it twice and slept a little easier.

Konrad Jngaf jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Konrad Kagr. The Concord medics will be busy. (@k4a.gr) Konrad Jngaf went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Marek Askey put up a fight, but not for long. (@roman_askey_) Konrad Jngaf found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Konrad Jngaf read it while the kettle boiled.
jackhatessocialmedia: After 10 days of war, Q-F4 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Cyril Jackhatessoc.

Cyril Jackhatessoc mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Jackhatessoc. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Cyril Jackhatessoc wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Cyril Jackhatessoc tried to describe the smell of Greyhallow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Jackhatessoc. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Cyril Jackhatessoc closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Jackhatessoc. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Cyril Jackhatessoc received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Jackhatessoc. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Cyril Jackhatessoc saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Jackhatessoc. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Cyril Jackhatessoc joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. A letter from home reached Cyril Jackhatessoc before dusk. Cyril Jackhatessoc read it twice and slept a little easier.
jordancrowe_: The draft reached R-S11 on Day 6. Norbert Jordancrowe was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Norbert Jordancrowe won before reaching the end of his entry.
Norbert Jordancrowe got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Norbert Jordancrowe waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.

Norbert Jordancrowe was on watch at R-S11 when the night raid hit. The men found Norbert Jordancrowe at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Newnario of the Hegemony (@newnario).
Tobias "Rabbit" Jordancrowe arrived carrying the family name of Norbert Jordancrowe. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Tobias "Rabbit" Jordancrowe was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S11. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2). Tobias "Rabbit" Jordancrowe stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-S11. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2).

Cyril Jordancrowe took the same post at R-S11 where Tobias "Rabbit" Jordancrowe stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril Jordancrowe is number 440. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-S11 with the rations. Cyril Jordancrowe ate while listening to the revised orders.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Cyril Jordancrowe gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Cyril Jordancrowe drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Cyril Jordancrowe spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Cyril Jordancrowe waited for that to change. When it did, Marek "Button" Gergely was grazed.
Cyril Jordancrowe tried to describe the smell of Lindenbruck and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
kjellx25: Silas Kjellx told the sergeant he was a brewer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Silas Kjellx and Wendel Jesus carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Silas Kjellx mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Silas Kjellx wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Silas Kjellx made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Silas Kjellx laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

A sniper's bullet hit Silas Kjellx at S-F22. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz). Silas Kjellx has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance.
The bleeding has stopped. Silas Kjellx asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.

Silas Kjellx is back from the field hospital, thinner and quieter, with a tin whistle still in his pocket. Blackwater Canal has been won. Silas Kjellx listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The trench wall shook against Silas Kjellx's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Kjellx is number 312. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Silas Kjellx shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Silas Kjellx splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
A man asked Silas Kjellx to describe Halden without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Silas Kjellx of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Verdel Ridge. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Konrad Danhammer's name scratched on the lid.
Silas Kjellx wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Leopold Staryfins wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
On sentry duty Silas Kjellx watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
lauronendaniel: Severin Lauronendani took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Severin Lauronendani helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F2. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms, grazed. Severin Lauronendani cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Severin Lauronendani watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Severin Lauronendani found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
Severin Lauronendani of the Concord and Jonas "Smokes" Ryx of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Sunken Road. It is getting crowded.

A bullet found Severin Lauronendani at Q-F2, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Dietrich Hutchhll of the Hegemony (@hutchhll). The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Severin Lauronendani waited for that to change. When it did, Marek Jeanms was grazed. Severin Lauronendani was killed on watch at Q-F2. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Dietrich Hutchhll of the Hegemony (@hutchhll).
Otto "Bones" Lauronendani took the same post at Q-F2 where Severin Lauronendani stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Leopold "Hollow" Nekroticdeka and Otto "Bones" Lauronendani have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.

Otto "Bones" Lauronendani was on the dawn watch at Q-F2 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Otto "Bones" Lauronendani was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
nick.parrinello: Dorian "Mud" Parrinello arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
A bullet hit Dorian "Mud" Parrinello's belt buckle at N-F17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Roland Dav of the Concord (@dav.cl_).

Fever took hold of Dorian "Mud" Parrinello overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. A letter came for Dorian "Mud" Parrinello with a ribbon tied around it. Dorian "Mud" Parrinello kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
pospisiliktonda: Ulrich Pospisilikto told the sergeant he was a stonemason. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Ulrich Pospisilikto lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Ulrich Pospisilikto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Ulrich Pospisilikto. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Ulrich Pospisilikto saved the last of the sugar for Albin Tomvandeloos's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Albin's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet struck Ulrich Pospisilikto below the ribs at U-F5. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away.
Ulrich Pospisilikto returned to U-F5 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Ulrich Pospisilikto hit Gustav "Ash" Nikolozitchk with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@nikolozitchkoidze) Ulrich Pospisilikto came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir.
ryanstebbins1: Felix Ryanstebbins introduced himself as a stonemason from Millbank. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C6, Felix Ryanstebbins listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet clipped Felix Ryanstebbins's helmet at R-C6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Dietrich Marcusho of the Hegemony (@marcusho64). Felix Ryanstebbins fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Felix Yummygraingo was grazed. Felix Ryanstebbins ate breakfast without a word. The clerk counted the names twice. Felix Ryanstebbins is number 765 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Felix Ryanstebbins wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A round came through the loophole Felix Ryanstebbins was watching at R-C6 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Felix Kebapien of the Hegemony (@kebapien22).
No bed for Felix Ryanstebbins yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Felix Ryanstebbins spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-C6.
Felix Ryanstebbins was hit in the hip at R-C6. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Dietrich Marcusho of the Hegemony (@marcusho64).
Someone moved Felix Ryanstebbins's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
sardanonewsnetwork: Cyril Sardanonewsn arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R2 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-R2 changed before the cheering ended. Cyril Sardanonewsn shouldered another load.

Cyril Sardanonewsn (Hegemony) and Tobias "Smokes" Chris (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Sunken Road on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Cyril Sardanonewsn did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Cyril Sardanonewsn borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Cyril Sardanonewsn laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
A bullet went through Cyril Sardanonewsn's sleeve at S-R2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Xanderm of the Concord (@xanderm7802).

Cyril Sardanonewsn was carrying water up to S-R2 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Cyril Sardanonewsn did not. Shot by Pavel Saturdaynigh of the Concord (@saturdaynightinafieldrunning).
The bearers moved Cyril Sardanonewsn's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
sebastiano_maccario: Walter Maccario came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. Now serving as a sniper, Walter Maccario discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter Maccario helped stack spare sandbags at S-R9. Nobody asked when they would be needed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Walter Maccario bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Walter Maccario of the Concord and Marek Seths of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Sorrow Copse now wait for it before they sleep. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter Maccario is number 817 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Walter Maccario heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A Jack Russell terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario gave it a name: Bess.

The village shop had three kinds of soap. Walter Maccario stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Maccario raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Yann Somosmagios of the Hegemony (@somosmagios.bo). Bess licked Walter Maccario's face until he opened his eyes. Then it wagged its whole body. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Maccario is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Maccario drew the street leading to Coldwater. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Maccario. Walter Maccario read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Walter Maccario was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. A letter from home reached Walter Maccario before dusk. Walter Maccario read it twice and slept a little easier.
tyleraldridge45: The new rifleman gave his name as Tobias Tyleraldridg. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Tobias Tyleraldridg fixed the strap on Hugo Kitty's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F22. Tobias Tyleraldridg has learned to walk bent double.
Tobias Tyleraldridg and Hugo Kitty split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony spotted Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord repairing a parapet at Blackwater Canal. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Tobias Tyleraldridg offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Tobias Tyleraldridg. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Tyleraldridg jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Walter Juizy. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@juizy_44) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Tobias Tyleraldridg hit Dorian Robertoneill with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@robertoneill2008) Tobias Tyleraldridg went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Tobias Tyleraldridg looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier.

The whole squad at S-F22 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Tobias Tyleraldridg's bullet that found Leopold Bomb, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Tyleraldridg answered to number 354. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Tobias Tyleraldridg read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Tobias Tyleraldridg tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier.
At Sorrow Copse, Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord and Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A dog crosses no man's land at the Hanging Bridge every night, fed by Tobias Tyleraldridg on one side and Marek Seths on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Tyleraldridg smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Norbert Ware came out for a cup and was grazed. A letter from home reached Tobias Tyleraldridg before dusk. Tobias Tyleraldridg read it twice and slept a little easier.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Tobias Tyleraldridg asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
wubbarn: The new sapper gave his name as Florian Wubbarn. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Wendel Jesus and Florian Wubbarn made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Wubbarn went out with the wiring party at R-F4. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A bullet clipped Florian Wubbarn's helmet at R-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Quentin Joshgentile of the Concord (@joshgentile80). A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Florian Wubbarn could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Florian Wubbarn no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Wubbarn caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
The parcel for Florian Wubbarn contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Florian Wubbarn asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.

The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Florian Wubbarn folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Wubbarn set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian Wubbarn answered to number 258. Grey Mill has been won. Florian Wubbarn listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Florian Wubbarn. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Florian Wubbarn fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Wubbarn crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F17 holds again. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Wubbarn heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. A letter from home reached Florian Wubbarn before dusk. Florian Wubbarn read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Wubbarn went over with the night raiders and never came back. The flare caught Florian Wubbarn on the wire, halfway home.

Oskar Wubbarn took the same post at R-F4 where Florian Wubbarn stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Oskar Wubbarn transferred to the riflemans. The men in R-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
